description: This file defines a React component for a search box with suggestions, team selection, and keyboard navigation, used in the Mattermost web application.

classes.name: SearchBox
classes.description: A React forwardRef component implementing a search box with suggestions, team selector, and keyboard controls.

methods.name: addSearchHint
methods.description: Adds a search hint to the search terms and updates the input focus and selection.

methods.name: updateSearchValue
methods.description: Updates the search input value based on a selected suggestion or hint.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard events for navigation, selection, and closing the search box.

methods.name: changeSearchTeam
methods.description: Changes the selected team for search without modifying search terms.

methods.name: closeHandler
methods.description: Handles closing the search box when the close button is clicked.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focuses the input element and sets the cursor position.
